review.rationale: Methodological contract for Test Card T018. The evidence decision lives in docs/standard. Longevity, metabolic rate and body mass are taken as compiled in AnAge.

question: Is the lifetime energy potential (metabolic rate per gram times maximum longevity) independent of body mass and the same in birds and mammals, as layer 3 with one reserve per gram requires?

output.quantity: slope s and bird offset d of log10 LEP = a + s log10 M + d [bird]
output.domain: AnAge Build 15 Aves and Mammalia, quality acceptable or high, sample size medium or larger
output.accuracy: 95 percent percentile intervals from 10,000 species-level bootstrap resamples (seed 20261117); no phylogenetic correction.

model.assumptions: tau = F/P with F proportional to body mass and the same per gram in all species (scope declared by the author).
model.approximation: Resting metabolic rate stands for lifetime expenditure; maximum longevity stands for tau.
model.drive_environment: Captive and wild records as compiled in AnAge.
model.parameters: No fitting decides the outcome; the prediction is s = 0 and d = 0.

data_policy.holdout_policy: No holdout. Literature summary known before drafting (SEEN_SUMMARY), declared in Test Card T018.

system_partition.boundary: Species-level records compiled in AnAge; published values used only.

state_accounting.rule: One record per species as compiled.

couplings.map: Longevity records and respirometry compiled from the literature

observables.quantity: maximum longevity; metabolic rate; body mass

observation.source_state: Adult animals as recorded in the cited studies.
observation.readout: Maximum longevity (yr), metabolic rate (W), body mass (g).

components.reason: Applied upstream in the studies compiled by AnAge; not recomputed here.

error_budget.numerical: Bootstrap Monte Carlo error on interval ends about 0.003.
error_budget.approximation: Resting rate instead of lifetime expenditure; maximum longevity instead of typical lifespan.
error_budget.measurement: Species records carry no stated errors; bootstrap over species only.
error_budget.systematic: Field/resting metabolic ratio may differ between classes; captive and wild longevity mixed; no phylogenetic correction.
error_budget.omissions: Reptiles, fish and other classes not used.
error_budget.dependence: Species are related by phylogeny, so intervals are too narrow.
error_budget.acceptance: Outcome categories fixed in Test Card T018.

claim_boundary: Methodological coverage of the T018 comparison only; the evidence level is set in docs/standard. UET-distinct in the declared scope (rate-of-living).
next_action: Add a phylogenetic correction and field metabolic rates only as reported checks; they cannot change the T018 outcome.
